faqs.q: Can I start using IELTS Ultimate for free before choosing a paid tier?
faqs.a: Yes. Public guides and sample tools are open to everyone, and creating a free student account unlocks baseline practice sets across Reading, Listening, Writing, Speaking, Vocabulary flashcards, and initial Study Plan tracking.

faqs.q: How does IELTS Ultimate evaluate Writing and Speaking scores?
faqs.a: Evaluations score separately across all four official criteria—Task Achievement/Response, Coherence & Cohesion, Lexical Resource, and Grammatical Range (plus Fluency & Pronunciation in Speaking)—paired with actionable rewrite pointers.

faqs.q: Does the platform support both IELTS IELTS Academic?
faqs.a: Yes. Both Mock Simulations and Writing/Reading tracks include dedicated Academic modules (charts, academic essays, scholarly passages) and Academic Dedicated pathways (formal/informal letters and everyday workplace texts).

faqs.q: Where do online classes and live mentoring fit alongside self-study?
faqs.a: You can practise daily at your own pace with self-paced tracks and AI drills, then join free live clinics or small-group cohorts when you want real-time mentor interaction, essay review, or scholarship interview coaching.

faqs.q: Do I need an account to browse Resources, Services, or Free Live Classes?
faqs.a: No. Visitors can freely read all product guides, explore sample class schedules, register interest for live sessions, and review platform information. Signing in is only required when entering the personalized student dashboard or admin workspace.
